name: Ghost Town — Episode 1: The Hair Salon Ghosts

sequence.note: Cost Is Not The Reason (2026-09-03) argued the $199 price is affordable. Ghost Town argues the opposite risk: even if price isn't the objection, being invisible online is still costing these businesses customers today. Same offer and audience family, different pain point and creative format (video-episode series vs. static declaration), scheduled to start only after cost-is-not-the-reason's 4 drops finish (last drop 2026-09-03T15:30:00-04:00).

business_goal: Acquire small business owners — starting with independent hair/beauty professionals — who are discoverable nowhere outside a marketplace app (Booksy/Instagram DMs only) via the $199 Web Basics launch offer, using a recurring 'digital ghost' video-episode format instead of a single declaration post.

audiences.label: Hair Stylists, Barbers, Nail Techs, Estheticians
audiences.pain: Discoverable only inside a marketplace app or via DM — no independent web presence a customer can find through search, so every new client depends on the marketplace's algorithm and fees

video_scripts.target: Independent hair stylists and salon owners with no owned web presence

articles.title: Why Independent Hair Stylists Are Invisible Outside the App
